plugin-top-stories.name: Top Stories
plugin-top-stories.description: Shows a carousel of fresh headlines for newsworthy searches.
plugin-top-stories.heading: Top stories

freshHours.label: Freshness window
freshHours.description: Stories older than this are ignored. The carousel appears only when at least three stories are this fresh.

triggerMode.label: When to look for stories
triggerMode.description: The first option sends short topic searches to Bing News and shows stories only when most of its results are fresh. The second option looks only when a search mentions news (for example news, headlines, breaking or latest).

googleFallback.label: Google News fallback
googleFallback.description: Ask Google News when Bing returns too few stories. Google News stories have no thumbnails, and their links open through news.google.com.
